metadata.name: hardware-attested-agentic-execution-environment
metadata.title: Hardware-Attested Execution Environment for Agentic Financial Workflows
metadata.description: FINOS reference architecture defining an isolated, hardware-attested execution boundary for autonomous AI agents executing financial clearing and transaction workloads with RFC 9110 HTTP 402 micro-metering and IETF SCITT transparency.

nodes.name: Commodity Multi-Tenant Host
nodes.description: Commodity multi-tenant cloud or on-premise virtualization host treated as zero-trust.

nodes.name: Hardware-Enforced Silicon Trust Domain
nodes.description: Isolated confidential virtual machine or trust domain enforced by CPU silicon (Intel TDX RTMRs / AMD SEV-SNP VMPCKs) with memory encryption.

nodes.name: Autonomous Financial Execution Agent
nodes.description: Autonomous AI agent executing trading, rebalancing, or credit evaluation logic within the confidential enclave.

nodes.name: Deterministic Spend Allowance Engine (x402)
nodes.description: In-enclave policy gateway that intercepts external calls, enforces single-task and cumulative spend ceilings, and halts non-deterministic loops.

nodes.name: SCITT L1 Verifiable Transparency Ledger
nodes.description: Immutable append-only transparency service recording cryptographically signed audit receipts for regulatory compliance.

nodes.name: Universal Financial Settlement Rails
nodes.description: Multi-rail settlement layer executing atomic micropayments (EVM, XRPL, Algorand) upon verified policy clearance.

nodes.name: Regulatory & Internal Auditor
nodes.description: Independent compliance officer or automated regulatory auditor verifying enclave attestation quotes and transaction receipts.

relationships.description: Hardware enclave boundary is hosted within physical infrastructure while cryptographically isolated from hypervisor access.
Autonomous financial execution agent runs inside hardware-attested enclave boundary.
Agent routes all outbound API and payment transactions through the spend allowance guard via local IPC.
Spend guard negotiates HTTP 402 challenge and settles authorization vouchers on settlement rails.
Spend guard registers signed receipt and enclave attestation statement with SCITT transparency ledger.
Auditor inspects cryptographic audit logs, hardware attestation quotes, and settlement receipts.
